title: Privacy Policy
description: How Car Key Supply in Elbridge, NY handles website visits and car key service inquiries.
body:
This page describes the information involved in visiting the Car Key Supply website and asking about car key cutting or programming in Elbridge, NY.

## Service inquiries

If you contact us, the information you choose to share may include your name, contact details, location, vehicle year, make and model, and whether you have a working key. We use inquiry information to respond, check compatibility and availability, discuss a quote, and arrange the requested service.

## Website visits

The appointment form prepares a text message on your device. The details you enter are not submitted to or stored by this website. You review the message and send it using your texting app; your messaging provider handles that message. An appointment request is confirmed only when Car Key Supply replies. This website does not provide customer accounts or online payments. Website hosting can involve technical request information, such as IP addresses, browser details and requested pages.

## Vehicle model choices

When you select a vehicle year and make, your browser sends those vehicle details to NHTSA vPIC to load model choices. NHTSA may also receive technical request details such as your IP address. Your name, phone number, location and appointment notes are not included in that lookup. Manual entry is available if model choices cannot be loaded.

## Analytics and browser storage

We do not run analytics or advertising trackers of our own. The embedded Google Map is external content handled under Google’s policies. The appointment form does not save your details in browser storage. See the cookie policy for more information.

## Google Maps

The shop-location section includes an embedded Google Map. When the map loads, your browser connects to Google, which can receive technical details such as your IP address and browser information and may use cookies. Google handles that information under its own privacy and cookie policies. The directions button opens Google Maps in a new tab.

## Questions

For questions about information you have shared with Car Key Supply, use the business contact details provided on the website. Include enough information for us to identify the relevant inquiry without sending unnecessary vehicle documents.

## Updates

This page will be updated when the website's features or handling of service inquiries changes.
